title: Kirby's Dream Buffet is playable online on OpenPak
body: Kirby's Dream Buffet can be played online on OpenPak. Start a random match and the game will search for other players, but a room stays open only briefly, so begin searching within a few seconds of your friends to join the same table. If the seats are not filled in time, the game fills the empty places with computer players. On 19 September a real Switch and an emulator met through random matchmaking and played complete matches together.
footer: OpenPak Kirby's Dream Buffet — playable, not promised.
